styles.label: 现代
styles.promptSuffix: Contemporary modern interior, clean architectural lines, warm white and light oak, restrained built-ins, realistic natural light.

styles.label: 中式
styles.promptSuffix: Contemporary Chinese interior, balanced symmetry, warm walnut, pale stone, subtle ink-art accents, elegant and restrained rather than ornate.

styles.label: 北欧
styles.promptSuffix: Scandinavian interior, pale oak, soft white walls, wool and linen textures, functional furniture, generous natural daylight.

styles.label: 奶油风
styles.promptSuffix: Realistic cream-style interior, soft ivory and light beige palette, rounded but structurally faithful furniture, boucle and light oak, diffuse natural light, no excessive ornament.

styles.label: 法式
styles.promptSuffix: Contemporary French interior, ivory plaster, restrained wall moulding, warm oak and subtle brass, elegant proportions, realistic daylight.

styles.label: 混搭
styles.promptSuffix: Controlled eclectic interior, coherent warm-neutral base with limited terracotta and deep-green accents, mixed textures without clutter.

styles.label: 轻奢
styles.promptSuffix: Light-luxury interior, premium stone and wood veneer, restrained champagne-metal details, refined lighting, no gaudy decoration.

styles.label: 侘寂
styles.promptSuffix: Wabi-sabi interior, warm clay and sand tones, limewash, aged wood and travertine, quiet imperfect textures, minimal objects, soft natural light.
